result.summary: Found several layout and content issues, primarily related to horizontal cropping of cards and a category filter, plus a truncated restaurant name.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' (Trattoria Piccol...) is cut off at the right edge of the screen, with its image and text truncated.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll containers clearly indicate more content or adjust card widths so cards aren't abruptly cut off at the viewport edge.

issues.description: The category filter row (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) has an additional category cut off at the right edge, only partially visible.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade gradient or partial visual cue to indicate scrollability, or ensure the cut-off element is fully hidden/visible.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' appears truncated without ellipsis, making it look like a text/rendering error rather than an intentional truncation.
issues.suggestion: Add ellipsis (...) when truncating text to signal to users that the name is incomplete.

issues.description: The second promotional card (pizza with -20% discount) is cut off at the bottom of the visible screen without a visible title or details.
issues.suggestion: Ensure sufficient scroll affordance or spacing so users understand more content is below without it looking abruptly cut off.
